title: Record walker explicitly narrows register and stack arguments
claim: At 0x08021140, LevelLayout_WalkRecords zero-extends arguments 0, 2, and 4 to 16 bits and arguments 3, 5, and 6 to 8 bits before use. Argument 1 points to a count-prefixed record block: byte 0 is the count, byte 2 supplies configuration, and entries start at offset 8 with stride 8. Existing signed/unsigned 32-bit caller declarations are not evidence for the callee's scalar interface. The supported declaration is void (u16, const void *, u16, u8, u16, u8, u8); an exact typed record structure remains a separate reconstruction question.

provenance.location: 0x0802114c-0x08021198: argument loads, zero extensions, count and stride
